segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are mostly positive, saying it absorbs without clogging pores or adding shine, though one found it far too thin to feel moisturizing and broke out from it.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin, including winter and eczema-prone dryness, report it calms tightness and dry patches, but several say it's too light to use alone and layer it with a richer cream for lasting hydration.
segments.sensitive: The large majority with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, including some who use it to calm redness after treatments, though one reviewer had a severe breakout with bright red bumps and warns other sensitive-skin users away.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report it balances an oily T-zone with drier cheeks, reducing oiliness and breakouts without over-drying the dry areas.
segments.mature: The two reviewers in their 60s report added moisture, with one noting a visible improvement in her fine lines after two weeks.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal skin, which can turn dry or sensitive, appreciated that the formula is fragrance-free.

concerns.blemishes: A clear majority of acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers say it didn't cause new breakouts and some saw fewer over two to three weeks, but a substantial minority broke out badly, including one who traced it to the coconut oil in the formula (calling it comedogenic) and another who got fungal-acne bumps within 24 hours of each use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers dealing with dehydrated, flaky or eczema-prone skin, including through winter, report the milk noticeably calms tightness and dry patches within days. Several who need more intensive hydration say it's too light to use alone and pair it with a richer cream, especially at night or in winter.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly less redness in the cheeks or overall, including calming for skin left reactive after exfoliation or dermaplaning. Against this, the reviewers who broke out describe the breakout itself as red, inflamed bumps.
concerns.oiliness: The reviewer who tracked it most closely reports a visible reduction in oiliness and less congested pores after about two weeks; others with oily skin say it absorbs without adding shine or greasiness, though one found it too thin to feel moisturizing on her oily skin at all.
concerns.spots: The reviewer focused on pigmentation says the niacinamide works well for her, and several others separately describe a more even, brighter tone developing within one to two weeks of use.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the ceramides with supporting the skin barrier, describing skin that feels less tight and more resilient over time; no reviewer reports barrier-related issues from this product.
concerns.aging: The one reviewer who mentions it, an esthetician in her 60s, reports a visible improvement in the appearance of her fine lines after two weeks of consistent use.

extraits.texte: this broke me out BAD!!! I went from one small pimple on my face to a million small bright red bumps all over my face after using it for only 2 days. if you havw sensitive skin stay away from this

DO NOT get this if you are acne prone. i didn't realize this item actually has coconut oil in it which is highly comedogenic and i assume was causing a massive break out for me even though i had pretty clear skin for many months before. i have stopped for about a month now but i can already see my skin is recovering and the acne is way less severe/less frequent. such a shame because the lotion itself feels very nice and lightweight.

Unfortunately I don't think this is fungal acne safe. Every time I use this, within 24 hours I have fungal acne bumps popping up randomly. Which makes me sad because I can tell this does really well to make my face feel so plump and hydrated 😭

So I do indeed like this moisturizer and I would recommend it to someone who doesn't need as much intense moisture in their skin as I do. I drink a lot of water but my skin still needs a lot of moisture. My skin tends to be very dry, itchy, and the texture can be uneven. It can be a struggle to get my skin to hold moisture. Immediately after using this moisturizer my skin does feel slightly more plump and moisturized. There's no fragrance and I found the formula to be slightly soothing. When I felt the very watery and thin texture of the moisturizer I knew it wasn't going to be thick or rich enough to be my every day moisturizer. My skin soaked up the moisturizer and went back to looking dry too quickly for my liking. I think this would be best for those with normal to combination type skin. extraits.titre: ANUA Rice 70 Intensive Moisturizing Milk - New Holy Grail
extraits.texte: As someone with combination skin that's both oily in the T-zone but also has random very dry areas, finding the right moisturizer has always been a challenging balance. The ANUA Rice Milk isn't just another moisturizer, it's like giving your skin a tall glass of water (or rice milk lol) after wandering through the desert. This lightweight yet creamy texture melts into skin like butter! It absorbs completely within seconds without that greasy residue feeling. I love using this both morning and night. In my AM routine, it's the perfect hydrated base for makeup! At night, I layer and slug it on with serums to wake up with baby-soft skin. There is a subtle, barely noticeable scent and it never irritates my skin. What really impressed me was the instant hydration boost. My skin drinks it up immediately, leaving it plump and dewy without feeling sticky. The rice extract works wonders on my dry areas and my skin tone noticeably more even and bright. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.

extraits.titre: Lightweight Hydration that Seriously Impressed Me
extraits.texte: I'm not new to this brand and frankly, I've never really had a strong positive impression of Anua to begin with, so I was curious if this product might shift that. As someone in her late 20s focusing on preventative care, hydration and fighting hyperpigmentation are my two key focuses in skincare. The Anua Rice 70 + Ceramide Intensive Moisturizing Milk kind of shifted my original impressions of this brand. For reference, I have oily/combination skin. 🍚 The packaging of this sleek and easy to use. Aesthetics-wise though, it pulls a little clinical at first glance but I can see the apothecary-inspired angle they were going for. 🍚 The formula is surprisingly lightweight and absorbs well. This is such a pro for me as I have combination/oily skin type. I found this perfect for use in the hot weather as my pores don't feel congested. 🍚 I've noticed a visible reduction in oiliness after using this for about two weeks. My skin looks and feels more balanced, and my makeup applies more smoothly. 🍚 This moisturizer contains rice water, rice extract, and ceramides. I'm particularly a fan of rice-based skincare as it was one of the first skincare type to even my skin tone. Some great skincare ingredients included in this are niacinamide (brightening, anti-acne, moisturizing), phytosphingosine (anti-acne, skin-renewing), rice bran oil (antioxidant), Allantoin and Ectoin (for soothing). 🍚 This would be great for any skin type as it does not contain irritating ingredients.
